svg.title: Norwegian Atlantic Slope Current: source-reference connection, P1–P2–S1
svg.desc: Regional editorial connection through three source-provided reference coordinates. Nominal WGS84 reference length261.6km. Nine bend probes are geometry sensitivity, not physical uncertainty, annual variation, a diagnosed current axis or a500m contour.

g.text: Not a seasonal or error range.
